prompt: At this commit, Flash and Flash-Lite are at version 3.5 and Pro at 3.1 preview. Which belief does that correct?

prompt: Match each Gemini Pro tier to its input price per million tokens.

choices.text: Only the output
choices.why: The input moves too.

choices.text: None until the account passes 200,000 tokens in a month
